observation: The documented isolated tool-project layout exposed three coupled projection failures in agent-loop 0.16.3: projected Claude hooks loaded the host root autoloader instead of the isolated tool runtime, projected skills hardcoded vendor/bin/agent-loop, and sync-hooks omitted helper files that hook entrypoints required.

evidence.summary: Running the projected Claude SessionStart hook loaded the host vendor/autoload.php and failed because voku\AgentLoop\AgentGuidance\AgentDisciplineHook was unavailable there; the tool runtime lived under tools/agent-loop/vendor/.
The projected skill/subagent assets contained 144 vendor/bin/agent-loop command references although this repository's installed binary is tools/agent-loop/vendor/bin/agent-loop.
A hook bundle whose entrypoints required hooks/runtime.php passed init validate and sync, but sync copied only the registered entrypoints; execution then failed because runtime.php was missing.

hypothesis: Agent asset projection assumes the default root Composer layout instead of projecting the resolved CLI/runtime location and the complete executable hook bundle.
validated_conclusion: agent-loop 0.16.3 was not portable to its documented isolated tool-project layout without host-owned workarounds: runtime/CLI locations and hook dependencies need to be projected from the actual install rather than assumed.
